settings.question: How long will my order take?
settings.answer: Most orders arrive within three to six business days; launch weeks can run a couple of days longer. Custom clips take four to eight weeks.

settings.question: What if my package arrives damaged?
settings.answer: Tell us within thirty days and we will replace it or issue store credit.

settings.question: Can I return an opened item?
settings.answer: For hygiene, opened hair care and worn accessories are final sale. Unopened items can be returned within fourteen days.

settings.question: Can I return a custom clip?
settings.answer: No. Custom pieces are made just for you, so they are not eligible for returns.

settings.question: Are your hair-care products vegan and cruelty-free?
settings.answer: Yes. Every formula is vegan, certified cruelty-free and made without sulfates, parabens or silicones.

settings.question: Can I wear a claw clip in wet hair?
settings.answer: Yes, but wipe it dry afterward and avoid soaking it in the shower.

settings.question: How do I access my rewards?
settings.answer: Sign in at checkout with your account email and your gems appear automatically.
